audit_result.proof_trace: teamSchema validates discord_role_id only as z.string().min(1) (teams.ts:12); no lookup against generation_roles, no bot API validation, and no DB foreign key constraint to any managed-roles table occurs in createTeam (L54-76) or updateTeam (L78-100). An admin can store any arbitrary Discord role Snowflake, which the bot then uses verbatim during syncDiscordRoles calls.
audit_result.attack_scenario: A compromised admin creates or updates a team with the Discord role ID of a privileged role (e.g., server moderator) outside the bot's intended managed set; all members assigned to that team receive the elevated Discord role on the next sync cycle.

PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-002.text: assignRole must validate discord_role_id against an allowlist of managed roles.
PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-002.assertion: forall req: assignRole(uid, role_id) => role_id in managed_roles_allowlist
